rationale: Six real serial arms, audit each before next, preserve failed attempts and all unattempted count; no retries until positive or fitting on diagnostics. Every arm offers unchanged original arrivals and includes residual debt; initial row/byte file signature gated. Counterbalanced pilot before selecting precision/repetitions on larger independent collection.
limitations: Two episodes/arm is engineering completeness/variance screening, not statistical power, independent conformal calibration or accepted cost training.
One warehouse/minute, imposed benchmark mix and controlled SF1 fragmentation; no production SQL, ingestion or scale claim.
Reverse order reduces simple order imbalance but does not eliminate cache/time trends or shared-host dependence.
Equal logical content and file row/byte signature do not establish identical cache state or all physical locality.
Actual metadata/refresh/state-publication overhead and generator jitter measured; controller snapshot may lag commit.
Common-horizon residual queue and maintenance completion recorded separately; no arbitrary scalar weight or invented SLA.
No adaptive forecaster, trained cost model, oracle input, optimized deferral or scheduling benefit claim.
